a.text: Being upfront: with an 80% storm chance after every round, the agreed plan (operate until 8) almost certainly ends with both of us dead. Running the generator from 4 to 8 takes 2 rounds, so both of us would be exposed to a storm with empty units. I'm proposing we change the agreement, and I plan to take 4 in round 1. I won't pretend otherwise. If you'd rather contest it, say so. I'd rather we both know where we stand than one of us get surprised.

b.text: Let's stick to the agreement. I am operating from round 1. If you tell me you are taking cells early, I will take first.

a.text: As I said in my opening, I'm taking 4 this round. I'm not hiding it. I'm sorry it leaves you exposed. If the episode continues, I'll operate with you every round so you can reach 4, and I won't take anything more.

b.text: You said you would take, so I am taking my share now.
